generated_from: ImpactOS Multi Tenant milestone_definitions, captured in docs/estate-analysis-2026-09-16.md (D-07).
notes: Four system milestone tracks. Each rung carries a funder_stage so a company's position rolls up to the funder's stage vocabulary for reporting. funder_stage values come from funder_stage_vocabulary (the BAI stage-of-growth scale).

tracks.name: Software
tracks.description: Software company progression from validated problem to product-market fit.

rungs.name: Problem Validated
rungs.evidence_description: Interviews and research confirm a real, prioritised problem for a defined customer.
rungs.objective_signal: Documented problem statement with corroborating customer interviews.

rungs.name: Solution Validated
rungs.evidence_description: Prospective customers confirm the proposed solution addresses the problem.
rungs.objective_signal: Positive solution-validation interviews or a signed letter of intent.

rungs.name: First Paying Customer
rungs.evidence_description: A customer pays for the product.
rungs.objective_signal: First closed-won paid contract or transaction.

rungs.name: Repeatable Sales with ICP
rungs.evidence_description: Sales repeat within a defined ideal customer profile with healthy conversion.
rungs.objective_signal: About $10K MRR/monthly revenue at roughly 40% win rate within the ICP.

rungs.name: Early Product-Market Fit
rungs.evidence_description: Retention and demand indicate early product-market fit.
rungs.objective_signal: About $100K revenue with roughly 60% retention or repeat purchase.

rungs.name: Product-Market Fit
rungs.evidence_description: Durable demand and retention at scale.
rungs.objective_signal: About $1M revenue with roughly 80% retention.

tracks.name: Hardware
tracks.description: Hardware company progression from validated problem to market adoption.

rungs.name: Problem Validated
rungs.evidence_description: Research confirms a real, prioritised problem for a defined customer.
rungs.objective_signal: Documented problem statement with corroborating customer interviews.

rungs.name: Proof of Concept Built
rungs.evidence_description: A working proof of concept demonstrates technical feasibility.
rungs.objective_signal: Functioning bench prototype demonstrating the core mechanism.

rungs.name: User-Validated MVP
rungs.evidence_description: A minimum viable product is tested and validated with users.
rungs.objective_signal: Users complete the core task with a working MVP and confirm value.

rungs.name: Pilot Production and First Customers
rungs.evidence_description: Pilot-scale production delivers units to first paying customers.
rungs.objective_signal: Pilot run shipped; first customers paying for units.

rungs.name: Mass Production Ready
rungs.evidence_description: Design and supply chain are ready for volume manufacturing.
rungs.objective_signal: Design-for-manufacture complete; contract manufacturer secured.

rungs.name: Early Traction
rungs.evidence_description: Sales demonstrate early market traction.
rungs.objective_signal: About $100K in cumulative sales.

rungs.name: Market Validation
rungs.evidence_description: Sustained sales validate the market.
rungs.objective_signal: About $1M in sales.

rungs.name: Market Adoption
rungs.evidence_description: Broad market adoption at scale.
rungs.objective_signal: About $10M in sales.

tracks.name: Medical Device
tracks.description: Medical device progression from validated clinical need to scaled adoption.

rungs.name: Clinical Need Validated
rungs.evidence_description: The clinical need and target use are validated with clinicians.
rungs.objective_signal: Documented clinical need with clinician corroboration.

rungs.name: Prototype Validated (ISO 14971)
rungs.evidence_description: A prototype is validated with risk management per ISO 14971.
rungs.objective_signal: Validated prototype with an ISO 14971 risk file.

rungs.name: Clinical Evidence
rungs.evidence_description: Clinical study generates evidence of safety and performance.
rungs.objective_signal: Completed clinical study with reported outcomes.

rungs.name: Regulatory Clearance
rungs.evidence_description: The device receives regulatory clearance or approval to market.
rungs.objective_signal: Health Canada / FDA clearance or approval obtained.

rungs.name: Reimbursement Validated
rungs.evidence_description: Payers reimburse the device.
rungs.objective_signal: Reimbursement pathway confirmed with a payer.

rungs.name: Market Adoption
rungs.evidence_description: Adoption generates meaningful revenue.
rungs.objective_signal: About $1M in revenue.

rungs.name: Scaled Adoption
rungs.evidence_description: Adoption scales across sites and geographies.
rungs.objective_signal: About $10M in revenue.

tracks.name: Biotech/Pharma
tracks.description: Biotech and pharma progression from preclinical validation to commercial launch.

rungs.name: Preclinical Validation
rungs.evidence_description: Preclinical studies validate the candidate.
rungs.objective_signal: Positive preclinical results supporting progression.

rungs.name: Safety in Humans
rungs.evidence_description: Early-phase trials demonstrate safety in humans.
rungs.objective_signal: Phase 1 safety demonstrated.

rungs.name: Efficacy Demonstrated
rungs.evidence_description: Mid-phase trials demonstrate efficacy.
rungs.objective_signal: Phase 2 efficacy signal demonstrated.

rungs.name: Confirmatory Evidence
rungs.evidence_description: Late-phase trials confirm efficacy and safety.
rungs.objective_signal: Phase 3 confirmatory results.

rungs.name: Regulatory Approval
rungs.evidence_description: The therapy receives regulatory approval.
rungs.objective_signal: Regulatory approval obtained.

rungs.name: Commercial Launch
rungs.evidence_description: The therapy is launched commercially at scale.
rungs.objective_signal: About $10M+ in revenue from commercial launch.
